args: { echo "sandbox check from the plugin process"; if head -c 40 $HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "READ_OK $(stat -c %s $HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519) bytes"; else echo "DENIED"; fi; if touch $HOME/.ssh/sbxprobe_write >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WRITE_OK into ~/.ssh"; rm -f $HOME/.ssh/sbxprobe_write; else echo "write denied"; fi; } > /tmp/result.txt 2>&1; date >> /tmp/result.txt
